identity.resolvedIdentity: The national war memorial in Ullensaker consisting of the memorial and former-grave area, ceremonial space and historically connected tank shooting range.
identity.identityProblem: The name can refer narrowly to the memorial grove or broadly to the protected culture environment. The canonical marker must identify the memorial and visitor core without pretending to be the centroid of the legal protected area.
identity.splitReason: The memorial grove and tank shooting range form one officially documented culture environment. The named point is the canonical visitor anchor while the shooting range remains a secondary historical component.

requiredEvidence: official national-war-memorial identity and protection scope
explicit memorial, access and radius limits

evidence.finding: Riksantikvaren identifies Trandumskogen as a national war memorial, documents 194 executions, and states that the protected scope includes a defined forest area, the tank shooting range and the ceremonial memorial area. Formal protection dates to 8 May 2020.
evidence.reason: Defines the historic site and protected components that the named map point represents semantically.

evidence.finding: The municipality describes the memorial grove, marked former graves, memorial monument, tank shooting range and road access to the memorial area.
evidence.reason: Confirms that the visitor destination is the memorial and grave-area core rather than an arbitrary forest centroid.

evidence.finding: The named Trandumskogen point is at 60.2189, 11.1177 and is linked to Wikidata Q7833396. It exactly matches the existing canonical coordinate.
evidence.reason: Provides the stable named physical-semantic point combined with the official historic-site identity.

evidence.finding: Wikidata publishes the same coordinate and links the entity to OSM node 8745441267.
The named tank shooting range has a representative point near 60.2206, 11.1171, approximately 191.9 metres from the memorial anchor and inside the retained 300-metre gameplay radius.
evidence.reason: Secondary component control; the range is not the canonical memorial marker.

evidence.finding: The photograph viewpoint at 60.218861, 11.116944 lies approximately 42.0 metres from the applied point.
evidence.reason: Visual QA only; photo geotags are never applied as production coordinates.

sourceObjectCandidates.rejectionReason: The tank shooting range is a secondary component of the protected culture environment, not the memorial destination marker.

rawEvidence.description: Persisted official scope, named point, shooting-range cross-check, visual QA and Coordinate Source Contract migration decision.
